expectation: Only message_feedback_created, message_feedback_replayed, and message_feedback_conflict are projected.
Feedback is visible only when the audit event has both the target handoffRequestId and conversationId.
N9 feedback events without handoffRequestId remain hidden rather than being guessed into a timeline.
Human Operator feedback is associated through OperatorReply.handoffRequestId.
AI feedback without an explicit handoff association is not projected to Staff timeline.
created maps to succeeded, replayed to replayed, and conflict to rejected.
Staff sees fixed value and truncated message identifier, never feedbackId or raw metadata.
The existing handoff:read and conversation:read permissions remain required.
Unknown action, outcome, value, subject, or metadata is rejected or hidden.
N10 adds no endpoint, write operation, migration, report, notification, or AI call.
